Prototype 8 encodes N3 (100% pure) primarily through EEG (97%), with EOG (2%) and EMG (1%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+7.6 dB, sensitivity=16.8) and absence of γ (-0.7 dB, sensitivity=2.0).
The δ activity is present in 86% of each epoch (sustained), with moderate eye movements (SEM 55% active (likely EEG crosstalk)) and atonic muscle tone.
This is coherent with N3 physiology: δ elevated, δ dominant, EMG atonic — all confirmed.
